title: Foundation Report Before Selling in Houston: What Does It Answer?
description: Before approving foundation work on a Houston house, distinguish a visual inspection, engineering evaluation and repair bid, then compare your selling options.

faq.q: Is a foundation repair estimate the same as an engineering evaluation?
faq.a: No. Read who prepared the document, the question they evaluated, their methods and the work or conclusions included. A proposal to install repairs and an independent evaluation serve different purposes.

faq.q: Does every Texas home inspection include elevation measurements?
faq.a: No. TREC explains that its minimum foundation standards do not require specialized elevation tools or load and deflection testing. Additional services may have a different agreed scope.

faq.q: Does an old foundation warranty prove the house has no current issue?
faq.a: No. Review the actual warranty, covered work, transfer conditions and current observations. A warranty is not a substitute for an appropriate current assessment.

faq.q: Can Cash As-Is review a house before foundation repairs are finished?
faq.a: You can request an evaluation in its current condition and provide existing reports. Any proposed purchase depends on the property and written terms; needed safety, title or other transaction requirements still apply.
